newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Blast kills three in southern Russia.
newsitem.headline: Blast kills three in southern Russia.

text.p: The deputy prime minister of the south Russian republic of Dagestan escaped an apparent assassination bid on Wednesday when a roadside bomb killed three people and wounded three others, Interfax news agency said.
It said the bomb was placed by the side of the road in the regional capital Makhachkala and set off by remote control as deputy prime minister Said Amirov's jeep drove past.
The victims were the deputy premier's bodyguards and policemen travelling in another car with which his collided. But Amirov was not in the jeep.
Amirov has been paralysed since an assassination attempt near the site of today's blast in 1992, the agency said.
Bomb attacks have been frequent in Dagestan since the collapse of communism in 1991 unleashed a wave of organised crime and political violence.
